card.line: Sepharvaim was a city whose people Assyria moved to Samaria, and Assyrian leaders later named it to mock the LORD's power to save Jerusalem.

moments.title: People brought to Samaria
moments.text: The king of Assyria brought people from Sepharvaim and other places and settled them in the towns of Samaria to replace the Israelites who had been exiled.

moments.title: Gods of Sepharvaim
moments.text: The Sepharvites in Samaria burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim. They worshiped the LORD but also kept serving their own gods.

moments.title: The Rabshakeh's taunt
moments.text: The Assyrian official asked where the gods of Sepharvaim and other lands were. He said they had not saved Samaria, so the LORD could not save Jerusalem.

moments.title: Hezekiah prays over the letter
moments.text: A letter from Sennacherib asked where the king of Sepharvaim was. Hezekiah spread it out before the LORD and prayed for rescue, so all kingdoms would know the LORD alone is God.
